Karnataka grants second official language status to Tulu

Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar has announced that the Tulu language will be given the status of the second official language in the state. This decision fulfills a long-standing demand of the Tulu-speaking population in coastal Karnataka. The move is seen as significant for the Tulu community, which has been advocating for this recognition for decades.
